acne_inflammation.title: Mild Acne / Inflammatory Spot
acne_inflammation.solution: Cleanse gently twice daily with a salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide wash. Avoid picking and apply a non-comedogenic moisturizer.

teeth_staining.title: Surface Teeth Staining / Plaque
teeth_staining.solution: Brush with fluoride toothpaste, use dental floss daily, and consider limiting coffee, tea, or dark sodas.

nail_discoloration.title: Nail Bed Color Variation
nail_discoloration.solution: Ensure proper hydration and balanced nutrition rich in biotin and iron. If persistent, consult a dermatologist.
